accounting.exact_record_correct: records with all 127 post-BOS positions correct

callback.api_behavior: analyze_transfer_matrix returns an in-memory report and does not write; the CLI writes create-only under the TRR-0012 task root. Agent2 may invoke the API with repository_root bound to this worktree and persist the returned report in its own evaluator custody.
callback.baseline_wrong_and_improved: retained in paired inventory and excluded from fixed-AUC risk set
callback.historical_target: included as a mandatory condition; parameter_relative_l2 is UNKNOWN because no artificial amplitude is declared
callback.parameter_relative_l2: Use sanitized producer variant_parameters effective_relative_parameter_l2 plus effective_delta_l2_after_parameter_dtype/base_parameter_l2 when present; retain nominal requested amplitude separately; otherwise UNKNOWN.
callback.source_order_gate: Truth manifest must repeat panel_sha256 and domain_record_order_sha256; each domain truth binding must repeat record_ids_sha256 before any truth safetensor is opened.
truth_open_order: validate public freeze receipt and matrix hash
validate exact after-cut H/prediction null for Finance and Pile
open Agent2 truth manifest and truth tensors

output.content: Counts, fixed AUC outcomes, public geometry summaries, gate bindings, and truth manifest hashes only; no token arrays or source text.

public_gate.after_cut_null: exact H and full prediction equality required for both domains; failure aborts evaluator callback
public_gate.measured_public_gate_mode: CPU, one thread, public headers/predictions/geometry only; no truth opened

purpose: Truth-gated evaluator callback for the frozen expanded_fixed 14-cell transfer matrix; no new source selection, target capture, fitting, calibration, or threshold.

resource_estimate.basis: Sequentially loads one clean and one changed geometry cell; public gate measured 14.7 seconds and reads approximately 1.4 GB of geometry artifacts. Scoring estimate is unmeasured and must be recorded by the callback.

required_truth_properties: bytes and SHA-256 must match the manifest
panel_sha256 and ordered-ID declarations are checked before any truth safetensor payload load
truth_manifest_contract.truth_bindings: one read-only safetensors binding per domain, with exactly one tensor key truth_tokens and shape [32,128]; each binding repeats records=32, stored_sequence_tokens=128, and record_ids_sha256; Agent2 retains custody and invokes the callback
